intent: 来点好看的科技感粒子背景
pass_criteria: coherent, polished particle background (no debug look, no default-blue accident)
reads as 'tech' (e.g. grids, data streams, clean geometry, cool palette — planner's taste)
usable as a background: not overpowering, decent negative space

params: Use a point emitter so a precisely animated emitter can draw a clean upper data-stream path.
Moderate density keeps individual luminous particles visible instead of turning the upper stream into fog.
Low velocity lets the emitter animation create readable connected data trails.
Disc emission gives the stream a controlled planar spread rather than a spherical dust cloud.
Keep the particle ribbon narrow and intentional.
Long particle life leaves an elegant persistent trail across the upper edge.
Small particles read as refined digital points.
Size variation avoids an artificial uniform-dot pattern.
Restrained particle opacity preserves the dark background and negative space.
Opacity randomness gives the stream a subtle data-signal flicker.
Glow Sphere particles create polished luminous points.
Additive blending makes the cyan particles feel emissive.
Enable air resistance before turbulence and keep the flow controlled.
Add mild organic drift so the upper stream evolves between frames.
Use medium-scale turbulence for graceful bends rather than noisy jitter.
Set color at birth so the authored cyan color is used.
Use a vivid mint-cyan instead of default blue for a contemporary tech palette.
Give each particle a controlled electronic halo.
Keep the particle glow subtle enough for background use.
expressions: Sweep the emitter across the upper third to continuously write a flowing cyan data ribbon.

params: A second point emitter creates a complementary lower data stream without filling the center.
Lower density makes this a quiet accent beneath the primary cyan stream.
Slow movement produces a stable, premium background rhythm.
Disc emission keeps the lower particles aligned as a slender stream.
Limit spread to retain a crisp technical geometry.
Long-lived particles form a smooth lower-edge trail.
Slightly smaller particles establish depth behind the main stream.
Lower opacity keeps this violet layer secondary.
Gentle stochastic flicker suggests transmitted data.
Use luminous glow spheres for visual cohesion.
Additive compositing preserves a clean neon-light look.
Introduce a small flowing deviation between frames.
Broader turbulence creates a slow elegant undulation.
Avoid visual noise in the lower accent.
Set color at birth before applying the violet accent color.
Add a restrained ultraviolet accent that complements the cyan without becoming default-blue.
Provide a tighter halo than the primary stream for depth separation.
expressions: Send a violet stream in the opposite direction along the lower third, framing a clear central title-safe area.

params: Restrict bloom mostly to the luminous particle highlights so the navy background stays crisp.
Feather the glow threshold for smooth premium halos.
Add restrained HDR bloom rather than an overpowering haze.
Create a soft shared light atmosphere around the two particle streams.
Retain the sharp particle cores beneath the bloom.

prior_iterations.critique: The navy base and abundant central negative space are usable, but the intended polished tech particle background is not present yet. At t1 the frame is almost entirely empty except for a tiny violet cluster at the lower-right; the cyan upper stream is not visible. By t4, a sparse violet/blue particle trail has grown across the lower half, so there is frame-to-frame change, but it reads as a partially initialized emitter simulation rather than a deliberate, balanced composition. The visible particles are too dim and too blue-violet, with no clear cyan counterpart, grid, or clean framing geometry.
